question: Can the historical source-trained feature-only prompt-conditioned SAM3 boundary readout be restored as a contract-correct readout over Universal Field v1?
answer: No. The already-completed current-field full4 transfer is a useful transductive development diagnostic, but the historical heads and the 0.588944 row do not satisfy the current single-field, cold-start, open-query, prospective-evaluation contract.

facts: Scene-specific softmax temperatures 50, 40, 25, and 25 were selected for Figurines, Ramen, Teatime, and Waldo Kitchen.
Threshold and acceptance-guard variants were swept on the same four evaluated scenes.
The historical localization definition differs from the currently released frozen bbox-smoothed definition.

current_field_full4_transfer.interpretation: The old boundary head gives a small positive correction to a peak-component current-field baseline on all four scenes. It does not reproduce the historical semantic heatmaps or the 0.588944 row. The historical head itself contributed only 0.018222 scene-macro mIoU over its own much stronger and post-hoc-tuned coarse masks.

head_training_audit.persistent_state_violation: Four different scene-specific learned semantic heads are required in addition to Universal Field v1. Their weights encode exact benchmark-query SAM pseudo masks and are neither a single global frozen readout nor a per-query transient computation.
provenance_gaps: Historical head checkpoints contain path-valued configs but no SHA-256 binding to every SAM cache shard, source image, rendered training feature, or source field checkpoint.
The current transfer result records the head path but not the head checkpoint SHA-256 in its own provenance block.
Old SAM cache payloads bind the SAM checkpoint hash inside producer metadata but do not bind each source-image SHA-256.

current_field_identity.explanation: The transfer consumes primitive-query rows and rendered 1280-D maps from each Method-v1 source field. Universal Field v1 migration reports verify bitwise-equal RADIO decode and do not feed reliability scalars back into the decoder.

invalid_as: Universal Field v1 canonical method readout
evidence that Universal Field v1 reaches 0.588944 mIoU
promotion_decision.reason: The branch does not implement the missing query-independent instance hierarchy. It is a bounded boundary polisher conditioned on a coarse text mask, trained scene by scene from exact benchmark query names, with historical gates selected on the evaluation cohort.

next_contract_correct_route: Build query-independent automatic SAM proposals from legal source views and bind every source image, model, mask shard, and MPR authority by hash.
Lift proposal membership with exact front-to-back marginal responsibility while preserving observed, positive, negative, and unknown support.
Associate proposals across views into a query-independent part/object/group hierarchy stored as a typed structural capability derived from the one canonical field.

At query time, use only the authorized text to select hierarchy nodes with masked-region plus context descriptors; fall back to the primitive posterior when proposal coverage or identity confidence is low.
Freeze all thresholds on a disjoint development split before evaluating the four official LERF scenes.
